verses.author: model_A
verses.text: A boat leaves the harbor before anyone is awake to see it go.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
no one waves
but the water keeps the shape
of something leaving

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a gull circles once
where the wake has gone flat—
then follows no one home

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the shoreline forgets
the way footprints forget
whoever was standing there

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the tide comes in
smoothing the sand blank again
as if to say: begin

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the ferry horn fades
and the harbor holds its breath
before the next arrival

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
low tide leaves a coin
half-buried, bright side down—
someone else's luck to find

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
a gull picks it clean
of nothing, just curious
then forgets it too

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the sand keeps no ledger—
footprints erase footprints
until only wind is owed

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
someone calls it evening
though the light hasn't decided
what it wants to leave behind

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the porch light hums on
early, a small apology
to no one, for the dark

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
I sweep the same step
twice, three times, some debts
insist on being paid

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the broom finds no dust
only the shape of my hand
still holding on

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the light gives up deciding
settles for gray
that's how I know to go in

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a kettle starts to sing
before the water's ready
some things rush toward warmth

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
my coat still holds the doorway's cold
I hang it up anyway
some parting isn't over yet
